compare_two_benchmark_executables: run compare_bench.py with two benchmark executables to generate a difference report between their results
compare_two_json_benchmark_results: run compare_bench.py with two JSON benchmark output files to compare and report differences
check_inputs_validate_benchmark_args: use check_inputs to validate two benchmark inputs and diagnose abnormalities like output file overwrites
classify_and_validate_benchmark_file: use classify_input_file to determine if a benchmark input is an executable or JSON file
generate_difference_report: use generate_difference_report to produce a line-by-line comparison of two benchmark JSON results
